# EMF 兼容：Immersive Melodies

![跳跃演奏中！](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XLUpeCri/images/78a59aa9b67148fdd8a1da72ba2c0ae9610ba0b7.gif)

一款小型客户端模组，旨在让 **[Immersive Melodies](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-melodies)** 的乐器动画与 **[Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)** 的玩家模型正确配合。

已针对 **[Fresh Animations: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension)** 进行了测试，但理论上应兼容任何玩家动画资源包。


<details>
<summary>视频</summary>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3XB3MGHLTVk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>



## 特性

- 兼容 **[Fresh Animations: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension)**。
- 演奏乐器时不会被资源包动画覆盖。
- 应能配合大多数使用 EMF 的玩家动画资源包运行。

祝你游玩愉快 ^_^
